newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Ex-Im Bank backs oil service sale to Angola.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Ex-Im Bank backs oil service sale to Angola.

text.p: The U.S. Export-Import Bank said Monday it had agreed to guarantee an $88.6 million loan to Angolan state oil company Sonangol to buy $200 million in oil well services from Halliburton Energy Services.
Halliburton is providing well completion and remediation services over four years for Angola's offshore Cabinda field.

The loan by Societe Generale in New York to Sonangol will be secured by oil sale revenue in an offshore escrow account, a provision which allowed Ex-Im Bank to support the deal at a time when it was not open for routine transactions in Angola, Ex-Im Bank said.
The Angolan central bank, Banco Nacional de Angola, is guaranteeing repayment to Ex-Im Bank.
